Which booking site listed the lowest prices for Innsbruck hotels?

Sites with the lowest price there: Super.com at 2, the hotel's own site at 2, Traveluro at 2, Billabook.com at 1, Bluepillow.id at 1, Hotels.com at 1, klook at 1, Tripadvisor.com at 1 and 1 other site at 1 between them. Taxes and fees at Innsbruck hotels

At the 16 hotels with both an all-in and a before-tax going rate, taxes and fees, as the booking sites reported them to Google Hotels, added a median of 16% ($23 a night) to the before-tax going rate: from 9% at Montagu Bed & Beers to 20% at MEININGER Hotel Innsbruck Zentrum. At 2 hotels no site reported a before-tax price, so their prices are listed prices that may leave out resort or property fees. Our data does not split the gap into taxes and fees.
